query: Replaced computers and servers will be collected and sent to licensed recyclers for environmentally sound disposal.
Suppliers will take back end-of-life ICT equipment for recycling under the contract.
The project will support refurbishment centres to repair and reuse old computers and phones.
An e-waste management plan will set out how project equipment is stored and disposed of at end of life.
The environmental and social management plan includes provisions for handling electronic waste and used batteries.
The project will support preparation of a national e-waste strategy and regulation on extended producer responsibility.
Electronic waste generated by the project will be managed in an environmentally sound way.
